stories.title: Los Mossos registran dos domicilios y un local en Terrassa con los detenidos por el tiroteo contra dos guardias civiles y buscan a un cuarto implicado

en.title: Mossos conduct raids at two homes and a venue in Terrassa with detainees from shooting against two Civil Guard officers and search for fourth suspect
en.summary: Three people were arrested shortly after a shooting incident in Terrassa and one weapon was recovered. Police are searching for a fourth person involved in the attack.

stories.title: Los Mossos registran los domicilios de los tres detenidos por tirotear a dos guardias civiles en Tarrasa

en.title: Mossos search homes of three detainees for shooting two Civil Guard officers in Terrassa
en.summary: A vehicle pursuit on the AP-7 highway resulted in a shooting that wounded two Civil Guard officers. Three suspects from a criminal organization were arrested within hours and one firearm was recovered.

stories.title: Los dos decretos fracasan y Sánchez utilizará su derrota como coartada para agitar la calle ante un adelanto electoral

en.title: The two decrees fail and Sánchez will use his defeat as a pretext to stir the street ahead of an early election
en.summary: Two government decrees failed to pass after Junts withdrew support for a housing agreement. The government aims to turn this legislative defeat into an opportunity.

stories.title: Los acampados de Sol, tras la bofetada del Congreso a sus decretos: “De momento, nos vamos a quedar aquí”

en.title: Protesters camped at Sol after Congress rejects their decrees: "For now, we're going to stay here"
en.summary: Demonstrators gathered in Sol awaited a congressional vote on decrees. Protesters expressed their intention to remain despite the uncertain outcome of the vote.

stories.title: Feijóo reta a Sánchez a convocar elecciones tras el revés de los decretos: “Estamos preparados”

en.title: Feijóo challenges Sánchez to call elections after decree setback: "We are prepared"
en.summary: The PP leader uses parliamentary rejection of government measures to argue that Sánchez and his administration lack support in Congress and public backing.

stories.title: El Congreso tumba los dos decretos de vivienda de Pedro Sánchez y dinamita la legislatura

en.title: Congress rejects both of Pedro Sánchez's housing decrees and destabilizes the legislature
en.summary: Junts joined PP, Vox, and UPN votes to defeat the government measures. The president warned of significant damage from the parliamentary outcome.

stories.title: Feijóo exige elecciones a Sánchez tras el rechazo a los decretos de vivienda: “La escapada debe terminar aquí”

en.title: Feijóo demands elections from Sánchez after rejection of housing decrees: "The escape must end here"
en.summary: The PP leader calls on the government president to hold elections following the parliamentary defeat on housing measures.

stories.title: Sánchez decidirá en las próximas horas si adelanta o no las elecciones tras "analizar lo que ha pasado" y "cómo reacciona la sociedad"

en.title: Sánchez will decide in coming hours whether to advance elections after "analyzing what happened" and "how society reacts"
en.summary: The president made a surprise intervention attempting to pressure Junts, warning that history will judge them firmly for their actions.

stories.title: El Congreso tumba los decretos de vivienda y abona el terreno para un adelanto electoral

en.title: Congress defeats housing decrees and sets stage for early election
en.summary: Spanish Congress rejected government housing decrees, with opposition from PP, Vox, and Junts. The defeat creates conditions that could lead to an early election.

stories.title: Los Mossos buscan al segundo autor del tiroteo contra dos guardias civiles en Terrassa

en.title: Mossos search for second shooter in attack on two Civil Guard officers in Terrassa
en.summary: Police are investigating a shooting incident in Terrassa involving two Civil Guard officers. Investigators collected spent ammunition from pistols and shotguns at the scene.

stories.title: La caída de los decretos de vivienda en el Congreso abre la puerta a un adelanto electoral

en.title: Failure of housing decrees in Congress opens door to early election
en.summary: Congress rejected housing protection decrees after opposition parties Junts, PP, and Vox voted against them. The defeat leaves millions of renters unprotected and creates potential for political change.

stories.title: Los manifestantes del Congreso vuelven a Sol tras mostrar su indignación por la derogación de los decretos de vivienda

en.title: Congress protesters return to Sol after expressing outrage over repeal of housing decrees
en.summary: Around one thousand demonstrators gathered outside Parliament with heavy police presence to protest the rejection of housing decrees. Protesters expressed accumulated anger over the legislative defeat.

stories.title: Vivienda, el gran fracaso de Sánchez

en.title: Housing, Sánchez's great failure
en.summary: The rejection of two decrees approved by PSOE and Sumar indicates a legislative collapse. The government attributes its inability to pass legislation to opposition parties and Junts.

stories.title: ¿Puede el 'CEO de los automóviles' de Kering hacer que la marca de lujo avance al doble de velocidad?

en.title: Can Kering's 'CEO of automobiles' accelerate the luxury brand at double speed?
en.summary: Luca de Meo is implementing industrial production methods at the owner of Gucci and Saint Laurent, generating controversy over this approach.

stories.title: El G7 liberará 100 millones de barriles de petróleo y diésel por la presión de Trump

en.title: G7 to release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel under Trump pressure
en.summary: G7 nations will release up to 100 million barrels of crude oil and diesel over the next four months to ease pressure on energy markets, French President Emmanuel Macron announced.

stories.title: RTX logra un megacontrato del Pentágono para misiles interceptores por 21.600 millones

en.title: RTX secures Pentagon megacontract for interceptor missiles worth 21.6 billion
en.summary: RTX has won a major Pentagon contract valued at 21.6 billion for the production of interceptor missiles.

stories.title: El Ibex salva los 19.000 puntos, pero sufre su peor semana desde abril

en.title: Ibex holds above 19,000 points, but suffers its worst week since April
en.summary: The Spanish Ibex index maintained levels above 19,000 despite experiencing its weakest week since April. Economic data releases and stabilization in bond and oil markets provided some support to equities.
